plugins.name: code-comments
plugins.description: Comment rules that hold without being invoked: the load-bearing test, injected at session and subagent start.

plugins.name: dry-prose
plugins.description: Short, flat, plain-English prose for anything read while working. Writes new text, or sweeps an existing draft.

plugins.name: wtf
plugins.description: Answers at whiteboard altitude — the short plain-English version, drawn rather than described. Ships /wtf, /wtf-html and /wtf-brand.

plugins.name: grilled-cheese
plugins.description: Run a grilling session in a browser: clickable options, per-question threads, a live decision log, and vim keys. Ships a Go server the agent drives over ask/wait/reply.

plugins.name: interrupt
plugins.description: Draws a random lateral-thinking card with the interrupt CLI and reads the problem at hand through it.
